description: This source file defines a static class 'Dependencies' with a method 'ConfigureServices' that configures dependency injection for database contexts in an ASP.NET Core project, selecting between in-memory and SQL Server options based on configuration.

classes.name: Dependencies
classes.description: A static class providing service configuration for database contexts with support for in-memory and SQL Server databases.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures the dependency injection services to add database contexts based on the configuration setting for in-memory or SQL Server database usage.
